scientific_question: On optimizer phases and layers untouched by all prior fresh-chart gates, does a two-pass stateless current-Muon-matched hidden c_proj chart generalize beyond hidden64 strongly enough that the smallest useful depth can be implemented and performance-qualified without a learned dense basis or LoRA?

parent_results.finding: Stateless fresh hidden64 improved the stale control but stopped at validation CE 5.6122, 0.0204 above the accepted attention-plus-0.1 boundary.
Equal-coordinate hidden88/112 controls beat trace-free pair blocks on the already-scored phases/layers, but were not preregistered for promotion.

causal_protocol.hidden64_parent: At each held-out base update, select 64 edge-disjoint hidden-channel matchings from the exact current coherent Muon direction and fit the closed-form diagonal-metric Givens coordinates.
causal_protocol.two_pass_residual: Materialize the hidden64 source and current exact-Muon residual. Select a second independent residual topology from current information only and fit 24 or 48 additional stages, producing hidden88 and hidden112.

weight_space: 15-update future exact-Muon residual positive-line recovery and cosine
functional: post-GELU residual-output positive-line and fixed-scale recovery
new fit-window validation-gradient predicted CE decrease
new holdout-window validation-gradient predicted CE decrease
matched finite-step CE on both new windows
robustness: minimum per-layer/update train-gradient predicted CE decrease
metrics.aggregation: Report all 28 held-out layer/update cells across both validation windows, energy-weighted aggregates, minimum cells, and 8 model-level finite-CE comparisons.

candidate_pass: Candidate must improve over hidden64 by at least 1.15x on aggregate current post-GELU positive-line recovery.
Candidate must improve over hidden64 by at least 1.15x on both new fit and new holdout validation-gradient predicted CE decrease.
Candidate must achieve absolute 15-update future residual positive-line recovery of at least 0.015 and positive future cosine in at least 24 of 28 held-out layer/update cells.
Candidate must win at least 7 of 8 model-level finite-step CE comparisons against hidden64.
Candidate must have no nonfinite metric and no negative train-gradient predicted CE decrease cell.
registered_decision_rule.selection: Select hidden88 if it passes. Hidden112 may be selected only if hidden88 fails and hidden112 passes; do not choose extra coordinates merely because hidden112 has a larger raw aggregate.
registered_decision_rule.failure: If neither passes, close sparse fresh hidden-pair depth as insufficient for the remaining c_proj gap. Do not weaken thresholds or authorize training after observing the held-out result.

execution_constraints.do_not_disturb: the running 985M full-attention 20TPP job on Y400 GPU0

authorization.this_plan_authorizes: Implementation, focused tests, and one zero-update directly polled held-out diagnostic after exact-commit deployment.
authorization.if_candidate_passes: Authorize production two-pass optimizer implementation and a separately preregistered real-training-path MFU preflight only.
